# package value

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/iec61850ctl/pkg/formatter/value"
```

Package value provides value formatting utilities for IEC 61850 data types. This package converts protocol-level values (go-mms and domain types) into human-readable strings.

## Functions

### func FormatAttributeValueWithError

```go
func FormatAttributeValueWithError(value any, mmsType domain.MmsDataType, err error, attrNameOrPath string) string
```

FormatAttributeValueWithError returns a display string for an attribute value, or an error message if err is non-nil.

### func FormatBinaryTime

```go
func FormatBinaryTime(value any) string
```

FormatBinaryTime formats IEC 61850 BINARY\_TIME for display. \[]byte: 4 bytes = ms since midnight; 6 bytes = days since 1984-01-01 + ms (raw MMS). uint64: milliseconds since Unix epoch (1970-01-01).

### func FormatDataAttributeValue

```go
func FormatDataAttributeValue(da *domain.DataAttribute) string
```

FormatDataAttributeValue returns the display string for a domain.DataAttribute.

### func FormatDomainValue

```go
func FormatDomainValue(v *domain.Value) string
```

FormatDomainValue formats a domain.Value for display.

### func FormatFileSize

```go
func FormatFileSize(bytes uint64) string
```

FormatFileSize formats a size in bytes to a human-readable string (GB, MB, KB). Returns the size with 2 decimal places and the original byte count in parentheses.

### func FormatLeafValue

```go
func FormatLeafValue(value any, mmsType domain.MmsDataType, attrNameOrPath string) string
```

FormatLeafValue formats a leaf attribute value for display by MMS type. For UTC\_TIME accepts domain.Timestamp, time.Time, or milliseconds (uint64/int64). attrNameOrPath is optional: when set, BIT\_STRING is decoded as quality only if attrNameOrPath is "q" or ends with ".q".

### func FormatMmsValue


FormatMmsValue formats a go-mms Value for display using its type and payload.

### func FormatQuality

```go
func FormatQuality(q *domain.Quality) string
```

FormatQuality converts IEC 61850 Quality flags to a human-readable string. Returns empty string if quality is nil.

### func FormatQualityValue

```go
func FormatQualityValue(value any) string
```

FormatQualityValue formats a quality bitfield value to human-readable flags.

### func FormatTypeSpec

```go
func FormatTypeSpec(spec *mms.TypeSpec) string
```

FormatTypeSpec formats a go-mms TypeSpec into a human-readable type string. For structures and arrays, it includes element counts. Returns "UNKNOWN" if spec is nil.

### func FormatUnixTimestamp

```go
func FormatUnixTimestamp(value any) string
```

FormatUnixTimestamp converts a Unix timestamp (seconds since 1970-01-01) to a human-readable string. Supports int64, uint64, int32, uint32, int. Returns RFC 3339 format with Unix timestamp in parentheses.

### func FormatUtcTimeFromTime

```go

```

FormatUtcTimeFromTime formats a UTC time with optional TimeQuality byte.


FormatUtcTimeValue formats an IEC 61850 UTC\_TIME value for display. Accepts milliseconds since epoch and the TimeQuality byte.
